name: host_command
description: Execute a bash command on the Pi host. Use for system inspection (df, free, systemctl, docker, ls, cat, grep, etc).

purpose.description: One sentence: why this command is needed for the current investigation

name: occ_command
description: Execute a Nextcloud occ CLI command inside the app container. Use for Nextcloud config, maintenance, and status checks.

command.description: The occ subcommand and arguments (without the leading 'occ')

purpose.description: One sentence: why this occ command is needed

name: container_action
description: Start, stop, or restart a Docker Compose service container.

name.description: Service name as defined in docker-compose.yml (e.g. 'web', 'app', 'db')

purpose.description: One sentence: why this container action is needed

name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a file on the host. Returns up to `lines` lines from the end of the file.

lines.description: Number of lines to return from end of file (default 50)

name: edit_file
description: Make an exact string replacement in a file. find must match exactly once.

find.description: Exact string to find (must match exactly once in the file)

name: reply
description: Send a final answer to the user and close the investigation. Use when you have completed the task or have a definitive answer.

message.description: The final reply to show the user

status.description: Outcome status: FIXED (verified fix), NOTHING_TO_FIX, BLOCKED (unable to proceed), INFO (informational answer)
